import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Identify the rows corresponding to the relevant indicators
labor_productivity_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)']
education_primary_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)']
education_secondary_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)']
export_growth_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)']

# Extract the relevant data and reshape to long format for each country group
def reshape_data(row, country_group):
    data = row.iloc[:, 4:].T.reset_index()
    data.columns = ['Year', 'Value']
    data['Country Group'] = country_group
    data['Indicator'] = row['Series Name'].values[0]
    return data

# Reshape each indicator for each country group
labor_productivity_data = reshape_data(labor_productivity_row, labor_productivity_row.iloc[0, 0])
education_primary_data = reshape_data(education_primary_row, education_primary_row.iloc[0, 0])
education_secondary_data = reshape_data(education_secondary_row, education_secondary_row.iloc[0, 0])
export_growth_data = reshape_data(export_growth_row, export_growth_row.iloc[0, 0])

# Combine all the data into a single DataFrame
data = pd.concat([labor_productivity_data, education_primary_data, education_secondary_data, export_growth_data], axis=0)
